theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Consumer Discretionary (+1.83%) and Communication Svcs (+0.56%) led the market today, while Energy (-3.04%) and Technology (-1.98%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +0.14% versus -0.47% for defensives and -1.23% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +0.30% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at -1.20%. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.46%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 3.03% to 24.68, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 1.66% to $3,723.80, crude oil was little changed at $82.43, and bitcoin slipped 3.50% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
